description: This file defines onboarding-related logic for an iOS application, including enums for connection modes and a singleton-like structure managing onboarding state with UserDefaults.

methods.name: shouldPresentOnLaunch
methods.description: Determines if onboarding should be presented on app launch based on onboarding completion status, last connection, and app model.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed and records the mode and timestamp.

methods.name: shouldPresentFirstRunIntro
methods.description: Checks if the first run introduction should be shown.

methods.name: markFirstRunIntroSeen
methods.description: Marks that the first run intro has been viewed.

methods.name: lastMode
methods.description: Retrieves the last connection mode from UserDefaults.
